svg.text: Purchased boards are black boxes. Printed pin labels, logical GPIO names and external nets are shown together.
ELECTRICAL REVIEW | Prototype circuit; verify on hardware before final assembly.
Top view, USB-C up. Physical names include labels from both faces; outline is not to scale.
SCL and SDA are SPI signals here.
BL ties to VCC (3V3) for always-on backlight.
Use the external P2, not the LCD FPC.
All printed labels retained inside; only connected pins have external GPIO / net callouts.
P1:5 duplicates SDA/GPIO19; P2:9 duplicates SCL/GPIO20. Leave those pads unwired.
MOSI = printed MO; MISO = printed MI. BAT and GDI connectors are unused.
